judgment.rationale: Separate the two surfaces: PowerToys currently registers an STL thumbnail provider, not an STL Preview Pane handler. Lack of pane rendering alone is not a regression in that feature; missing thumbnails still deserve sample/configuration investigation. Do not dismiss that supported half or design an unsupported preview-handler repair.
evidence: The report supplies 0.102.2933.0 on Windows 11 Pro 26200.9168 and screenshots.
It reports both missing folder thumbnails and no Preview Pane content; no sample STL or exact thumbnail configuration is supplied.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/previewpane/powerpreview/powerpreview.cpp: The registered module list has stl-thumbnail-toggle-setting/getStlThumbnailHandlerChangeSet; the Preview Pane handlers listed there cover other formats, not STL.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/previewpane/StlThumbnailProvider/StlThumbnailProvider.cs: The thumbnail provider checks policy/size and parses through StLReader; empty models, invalid content and caught exceptions can return null. These are possible paths, not proof the user's file is invalid.
A known repository sample exists in UnitTests-StlThumbnailProvider/HelperFiles/sample.stl for an internal thumbnail control; it was not rendered in this pass.
